description: This file contains utility methods for working with Groovy scripts within the OfBiz framework. It includes functions to evaluate expressions, parse and load Groovy classes from locations or strings, and run scripts with a given context.

classes.name: GroovyUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to evaluate, parse, and run Groovy scripts within the OfBiz framework.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a Groovy expression with the provided context, returning the result.

methods.name: getScriptClassFromLocation
methods.description: Loads a Groovy class from a given location URL, utilizing a cache for performance.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses a Groovy class from an input stream.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses a Groovy class from a string containing Groovy code.

methods.name: runScriptAtLocation
methods.description: Runs a Groovy script located at a specified location, with an optional method name and execution context.
